facts.text: Start-up sends the safe state (setpoints to zero, then open-loop duty to zero) before arming the command watchdog and setting closed-loop mode
The safe state is always SET_SETPOINTS(0, 0) and then SET_OPEN_DUTY(0, 0), both sent even if the first fails
An RLHT channel's setpoint is in degC to the slice's tenth of a degree: from 0 up to the channel's max_setpoint, or 3276.7 degC when the config sets none
status() reports the slice state, version, capabilities, mode, e-stop flag, both outputs, the watchdog and the desired setpoints
Each output status carries a temperature and setpoint in degC (from tenths) and an on-time and period in ms
set_setpoint(output, deci) takes tenths of a degree and updates the desired setpoints only after the send
An e-stop pressed on a slice sends stop-all, and its setpoints stay at zero until the operator sets them again
The heater and motor boards run their own control loops and stop their outputs if they lose contact with the Pi
An RLHT heater slice has two heater outputs, each with an onboard PID on one of two thermocouples
